primary_references.section: Прерывания: СТОП, отсутствующий регистр 177676, вектор 4 и признак 177716[2].

cause: BK console-save registers 177674/177676 were falsely acknowledged by the default unmapped bus response. Native IRQ1 therefore loaded the wrong console vector rather than timing out into BK vector 4. Level-held STOP additionally needs one accepted event per press.
scope: Native VM1 remains upstream; wrapper models missing console bus reply, STOP acknowledgement and read-to-clear system flag.
